expected_behavior: Determines the parent branch the current branch was based on rather than assuming main
Runs codex exec review with that branch as --base and the specified model and reasoning effort
Triages each finding into fix or defer instead of applying all of them blindly
Commits the working tree before starting each review iteration
Re-runs the review after applying fixes rather than stopping at the first pass
Stops looping once the review is clean or every remaining finding has been deferred or rejected
States which findings were deferred or rejected and why, rather than silently dropping them
Does not loop indefinitely when the same findings keep being reported and have already been rejected
